# Record formats (easel)

<!-- generated by tools/gen_formats_doc.py from schemas/*.schema.json; do not edit by hand -->

Every record easel writes is a YAML or JSON file, or one line of a JSONL log, described by a JSON Schema
(draft 2020-12) in `schemas/`. A record's first key is `schema: "<repo>/<name>/<version>"`; a new
version always comes with a reader for the old one. Worked examples are in `schemas/examples/`. Read
records through the commands in [REGISTRY.md](../REGISTRY.md); never edit one by hand.

## candidates-entry

one vetted search result: One line of <home>/candidates/<date>.jsonl, written by `easel search vet <url>`: what the public API says about a model version and the class it falls into. `registry add` takes an ok row into pending/.

- schema: `easel/candidates-entry/1`
- file: [schemas/candidates-entry.schema.json](../../schemas/candidates-entry.schema.json)
- example: [schemas/examples/candidates-entry.example.json](../../schemas/examples/candidates-entry.example.json)

| field | type | required | meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `schema` | `easel/candidates-entry/1` | yes | the format and its version; always the first key |
| `at` | string | yes | ISO 8601 time, for example 2030-01-01T00:00:00+00:00; easel always writes the T and the UTC offset. |
| `v` | `1` | yes | the line format's version: the number at the end of `schema`, so a reader can branch without parsing the string |
| `source` | string | yes | where the line's content comes from: `operator` (the person), the second source (policy.second_source_name, default `assistant`), or a tool, for example `kiln:images import` or `easel:workflows validate` |
| `by` | string | no | the command that wrote the line, for example `kiln images label` (optional) |
| `site` | one of `civitai`, `huggingface` | yes |  |
| `url` | string | yes | an http(s) URL |
| `query` | string or null | no |  |
| `model_id` | string | yes |  |
| `version_id` | string or null | no |  |
| `name` | string | yes |  |
| `type` | one of `checkpoint`, `lora`, `lycoris`, `vae`, `text_encoder`, `clip`, `clip_vision`, `controlnet`, `ipadapter`, `upscaler`, `embedding`, `detector`, `sam`, `style_model`, `unet`, `model_patch`, `other` | yes |  |
| `family` | string or null | no |  |
| `base_model` | string or null | no |  |
| `file_name` | string or null | no |  |
| `bytes` | integer or null | no |  |
| `sha256` | string or null | no |  |
| `rating` | one of `sfw`, `suggestive`, `explicit`, `unknown` | yes | content rating; unknown is treated as not sfw (policy.unknown_rating_is) |
| `licence` | object | yes | a model's licence terms as read from its source. Read by `registry audit`, `recipe propose --explain`, `kiln train plan` (copied into run.json) and `kiln release build` (which refuses when status is unknown, derivatives_allowed is false, or relicense_allowed is false while the LoRA's licence differs). null in a field = not known |
| `licence.status` | one of `verified`, `unverified`, `unknown` | yes | verified = a person read the licence text; unverified = taken from site metadata; unknown = nothing known yet |
| `licence.name` | string or null | no | the licence's name as its source gives it |
| `licence.spdx` | string or null | no | SPDX id when one exists, for example Apache-2.0 |
| `licence.url` | string or null | no |  |
| `licence.commercial_use` | one of `none`, `images`, `rent`, `sell`, `null` | no | Civitai allowCommercialUse mapped: none \| images \| rent \| sell |
| `licence.credit_required` | boolean or null | no | Civitai allowNoCredit inverted |
| `licence.derivatives_allowed` | boolean or null | no | Civitai allowDerivatives |
| `licence.relicense_allowed` | boolean or null | no | Civitai allowDifferentLicense |
| `licence.redistributable` | boolean or null | no |  |
| `licence.gated` | boolean or null | no | true = downloading needs a login or an accepted form |
| `licence.source` | string or null | no | where the terms come from: civitai-api \| hf-card \| model-card \| manual \| family-summary |
| `licence.checked_at` | string or string or null | no |  |
| `licence.note` | string or null | no |  |
| `class` | one of `ok`, `licence-unclear`, `rating-conflict`, `gated`, `too-big` | yes |  |
| `reasons` | array of string | yes | one line per reason the class was given |

## changelog-event

one change to the registry: One line of <home>/registry/changelog.jsonl, appended by every registry write: what changed on which record, old and new value per field.

- schema: `easel/changelog-event/1`
- file: [schemas/changelog-event.schema.json](../../schemas/changelog-event.schema.json)
- example: [schemas/examples/changelog-event.example.json](../../schemas/examples/changelog-event.example.json)

| field | type | required | meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `schema` | `easel/changelog-event/1` | yes | the format and its version; always the first key |
| `at` | string | yes | ISO 8601 time, for example 2030-01-01T00:00:00+00:00; easel always writes the T and the UTC offset. |
| `v` | `1` | yes | the line format's version: the number at the end of `schema`, so a reader can branch without parsing the string |
| `source` | string | yes | where the line's content comes from: `operator` (the person), the second source (policy.second_source_name, default `assistant`), or a tool, for example `kiln:images import` or `easel:workflows validate` |
| `by` | string | no | the command that wrote the line, for example `kiln images label` (optional) |
| `action` | one of `add`, `update`, `set`, `unset`, `archive`, `restore`, `scan`, `download`, `import` | yes |  |
| `target` | object | yes |  |
| `target.kind` | one of `resource`, `recipe`, `workflow`, `family`, `card`, `override` | yes |  |
| `target.id` | string | yes |  |
| `changes` | object | yes | field (dotted) -> {from, to} |
| `changes.<key>` | object | no |  |
| `changes.<key>.from` | any | yes |  |
| `changes.<key>.to` | any | yes |  |
| `note` | string or null | no |  |
| `legacy_id` | string or integer or null | no | records imported from another store keep their original id in legacy_id; null for records made here. It lets an imported record be traced back and is never shown in public text |

## compat

compatibility rules between families: Which resource type trained on one family works on a checkpoint of another. `easel registry compatible <sha16>` joins it with the registry (a missing rule = untested, confidence 0). Shipped as data/compat.yaml; an instance may add rules in <home>/data/compat.yaml.

- schema: `easel/compat/1`
- file: [schemas/compat.schema.json](../../schemas/compat.schema.json)
- example: [schemas/examples/compat.example.yaml](../../schemas/examples/compat.example.yaml)

| field | type | required | meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `schema` | `easel/compat/1` | yes | the format and its version; always the first key |
| `basis` | string | no | where the rules come from |
| `rules` | array of object | yes |  |
| `rules[].source_family` | string | yes | a model family id: the stem of families/<id>.yaml |
| `rules[].target_family` | string | yes | a model family id: the stem of families/<id>.yaml |
| `rules[].artifact_type` | one of `checkpoint`, `lora`, `lycoris`, `vae`, `text_encoder`, `clip`, `clip_vision`, `controlnet`, `ipadapter`, `upscaler`, `embedding`, `detector`, `sam`, `style_model`, `unet`, `model_patch` | yes |  |
| `rules[].verdict` | one of `native`, `works`, `degraded`, `broken`, `untested` | yes |  |
| `rules[].confidence` | number | yes |  |
| `rules[].reason` | string or null | no |  |

## config

easel instance configuration (easel.toml): The one TOML file at the instance root (<home>/easel.toml). Found in this order: --workspace, $EASEL_HOME, upward from the current folder, ~/.config/easel/. Any key can be overridden with EASEL_<SECTION>__<KEY>. `easel config set <section.key> <value>` validates against this schema and refuses an unknown key or a wrong type (exit 2, file unchanged). Absolute paths belong only in an instance copy, never in a shipped file.

- schema: `easel/config/1`
- file: [schemas/config.schema.json](../../schemas/config.schema.json)
- example: [schemas/examples/config.example.yaml](../../schemas/examples/config.example.yaml)

| field | type | required | meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `schema` | `easel/config/1` | yes | the format and its version; always the first key |
| `instance` | object | no |  |
| `instance.name` | string | no | a short name for this instance |
| `instance.adopted` | boolean | no | true = an existing workspace the tool works beside through its own runner |
| `paths` | object | no | where the instance keeps its data. Relative paths are relative to the instance root; ${VAR} is expanded at load time. images_root (kiln, adopted projects only) is read-only until cutover |
| `paths.root` | string | no |  |
| `paths.models_root` | string | no | <models_root>: the folder that holds checkpoints/, loras/, ... |
| `paths.extra_model_roots` | array of string | no | more folders laid out like <models_root> (ComfyUI can map several base paths), scanned after models_root; the first root that has a file name wins, and downloads always land in models_root |
| `paths.runs` | string | no |  |
| `paths.recipes` | string | no |  |
| `paths.registry` | string | no |  |
| `paths.journal` | string | no |  |
| `paths.runtime` | string | no |  |
| `paths.references` | string | no |  |
| `paths.candidates` | string | no |  |
| `paths.lessons` | string | no |  |
| `paths.standards` | string | no |  |
| `paths.jobs` | string | no |  |
| `paths.workflows` | string | no |  |
| `comfyui` | object | no |  |
| `comfyui.url` | string | no | the ComfyUI server's base URL; ComfyUI's upstream default is http://127.0.0.1:8188 |
| `comfyui.dir` | string | no | <comfyui_dir>: only when the tool starts and stops the server itself |
| `comfyui.python` | string | no | <comfyui_python>: that ComfyUI's interpreter |
| `comfyui.min_version` | string | no | the oldest ComfyUI version the graphs are tested with |
| `comfyui.manage_lifecycle` | boolean | no | true = the tool may start and stop the server |
| `comfyui.start_args` | array of string | no | extra arguments when the tool starts the server; none by default |
| `comfyui.timeout_s` | number | no | seconds to wait for one HTTP answer |
| `limits` | object | no | RAM needed per job comes from families/<f>.yaml host_ram_gb, not from here |
| `limits.host_ram_floor_gb` | number | no | free host RAM never given away to a job |
| `limits.disk_floor_gb` | number | no | free disk in GB that a download, a render or a write must leave; each instance sets its own |
| `limits.max_concurrent_gpu_jobs` | integer | no |  |
| `limits.skip_ram_check` | boolean | no | true = start jobs without measuring free RAM (only where it cannot be measured) |
| `scheduler` | object | no |  |
| `scheduler.kind` | one of `none`, `command` | no | none = wait for free RAM and disk locally; command = call the *_command templates |
| `scheduler.fail_open` | boolean | no | true = run anyway when the scheduler cannot be reached (default false: fail closed) |
| `scheduler.poll_s` | number | no | seconds between checks while waiting |
| `scheduler.stop_file` | string | no | a file whose appearance asks a running job to yield |
| `scheduler.plan_command` | string | no | a command template for this scheduler verb; written per machine, never shipped |
| `scheduler.ready_command` | string | no | a command template for this scheduler verb; written per machine, never shipped |

| `scheduler.requeue_command` | string | no | a command template for this scheduler verb; written per machine, never shipped |
| `scheduler.done_command` | string | no | a command template for this scheduler verb; written per machine, never shipped |
| `scheduler.cancel_command` | string | no | a command template for this scheduler verb; written per machine, never shipped |
| `scheduler.update_command` | string | no | a command template for this scheduler verb; written per machine, never shipped |
| `jobs` | object | no |  |
| `jobs.allowed` | array of object | no | the GPU verbs a scheduler may start for this instance; empty = none |
| `jobs.allowed[].tool` | one of `easel`, `kiln` | yes |  |

## family

model family (easel): One model family per file, families/<id>.yaml. The shared keys (all but `schema` and the tool block) are identical in the easel and kiln copies; `sync_common.py --check` compares them. A family with `inherits` reads the blocks it leaves out from its parent, except `licence_summary` and `host_ram_gb`, which every file carries.

- schema: `easel/family/1`
- file: [schemas/family.schema.json](../../schemas/family.schema.json)
- example: [schemas/examples/family.example.yaml](../../schemas/examples/family.example.yaml)

| field | type | required | meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `schema` | `easel/family/1` | yes | the format and its version; always the first key |
| `id` | string | yes | equals the file stem |
| `name` | string | yes | display name |
| `status` | one of `tested`, `experimental`, `unverified`, `listed` | yes | tested = trained or rendered with on the reference machine; experimental = run once, not in the tested path; unverified = priors only; listed = known, no recipe |
| `inherits` | string or null | yes | the parent family; a block this file leaves out is read from the parent (deep merge, the child's keys win) |
| `architecture` | object | no |  |
| `architecture.kind` | string | yes | for example unet-sdxl, dit-flux; unknown when not known |
| `architecture.latent_channels` | integer or null | yes |  |
| `architecture.text_encoders` | array of string or null | yes |  |
| `architecture.native_resolution` | integer or null | yes | the side length in pixels the family was trained at |
| `description` | string | no |  |
| `licence_summary` | object | yes | the base model's licence in one line; every family carries its own, inherited or not (families check fails otherwise). It is the fallback for foundation bases only: a resource's own licence block wins |
| `licence_summary.status` | one of `verified`, `unverified`, `unknown` | yes |  |
| `licence_summary.name` | string or null | yes | the licence's name, null when not recorded |
| `licence_summary.text` | string | yes | one line a person can act on, for example 'unverified: read the model card' |
| `licence_summary.url` | string or null | yes | the model card; null is allowed (families check warns) |
| `licence_summary.spdx` | string or null | no |  |
| `licence_summary.checked_at` | string or null | no |  |
| `host_ram_gb` | object | yes | what the scheduler waits for before it starts a job of this family |
| `host_ram_gb.train` | number or null | yes | free host RAM a training step needs |
| `host_ram_gb.eval` | number or null | yes | free host RAM an eval render needs |
| `host_ram_gb.eval_includes_comfyui_server` | boolean or null | yes | true = the eval number already covers the ComfyUI server |
| `host_ram_gb.basis` | string | yes | measured on the reference machine, inherited, or a prior; say which |
| `inference` | object | no | easel's render defaults for this family |
| `inference.basis` | string | no |  |
| `inference.graph_compiler` | string or null | no | the graph compiler in _common.comfy_graph; null = no template ships yet |
| `inference.note` | string | no |  |
| `inference.sampler` | string or null | no |  |
| `inference.scheduler` | string or null | no |  |
| `inference.steps` | integer or null | no |  |
| `inference.cfg` | number or null | no |  |
| `inference.clip_skip` | integer or null | no |  |
| `inference.resolution` | object | no |  |
| `inference.resolution.native` | array of integer | no |  |
| `inference.resolution.presets` | object | no |  |
| `inference.prompt` | object | no |  |
| `inference.prompt.style` | string | no | natural \| tags |
| `inference.prompt.prefix` | string | no |  |
| `inference.prompt.suffix` | string | no |  |
| `inference.prompt.order` | string | no |  |
| `inference.prompt.notes` | string | no |  |
| `inference.negative_baseline` | string | no |  |
| `inference.lora_default_weight` | number | no |  |
| `inference.hires` | object or null | no |  |
| `inference.vae` | object | no |  |
| `inference.vae.shared_with` | array of string | no |  |
| `inference.vae.not_interchangeable_with` | array of string | no |  |
| `inference.vae.note` | string | no |  |

## job

one scheduled GPU job: <home>/jobs/<job-id>.json: a GPU job submitted through `easel jobs submit` (or by `easel run`), what it needs and where it stands. Only verbs listed in jobs.allowed are accepted; the scheduler starts it when the family's host_ram_gb and the disk floor hold.

- schema: `easel/job/1`
- file: [schemas/job.schema.json](../../schemas/job.schema.json)
- example: [schemas/examples/job.example.json](../../schemas/examples/job.example.json)

| field | type | required | meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `schema` | `easel/job/1` | yes | the format and its version; always the first key |
| `id` | string | yes | a job id: job-YYYYMMDD-NNN |
| `created_at` | string | yes | ISO 8601 time, for example 2030-01-01T00:00:00+00:00; easel always writes the T and the UTC offset. |
| `tool` | one of `easel`, `kiln` | yes |  |
| `verb` | string | yes |  |
| `args` | array of string | yes | the verb's arguments, for example [rcp-20300101-001] |
| `title` | string | no |  |
| `by` | string | no | who submitted it: operator or the agent's name |
| `family` | string or null | no |  |
| `host_ram_gb` | number | yes | free host RAM it waits for |
| `minutes` | integer | yes | expected wall clock |
| `pausable` | boolean | yes |  |

| `comfyui` | object | no |  |

## run-review-event

a verdict on a run's output: One line of <home>/runs/<run-id>/reviews.jsonl. The operator's latest line per (run, n) is the current verdict (`easel runs reviews --current`); changing one's mind appends a line, and the second source's lines are kept apart, never current. Written by `easel runs review`, the review page and `runs import-legacy --with-reviews`, all through the store lock. `source` is who judged: `operator`, or the second source for its labelled reads.

- schema: `easel/run-review-event/1`
- file: [schemas/run-review-event.schema.json](../../schemas/run-review-event.schema.json)
- example: [schemas/examples/run-review-event.example.json](../../schemas/examples/run-review-event.example.json)

| field | type | required | meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `schema` | `easel/run-review-event/1` | yes | the format and its version; always the first key |
| `at` | string | yes | ISO 8601 time, for example 2030-01-01T00:00:00+00:00; easel always writes the T and the UTC offset. |
| `v` | `1` | yes | the line format's version: the number at the end of `schema`, so a reader can branch without parsing the string |
| `source` | string | yes | where the line's content comes from: `operator` (the person), the second source (policy.second_source_name, default `assistant`), or a tool, for example `kiln:images import` or `easel:workflows validate` |
| `by` | string | no | the command that wrote the line, for example `kiln images label` (optional) |
| `run` | string | yes | a run id: run-YYYYMMDD-<slug>, for example run-20300101-001 |
| `n` | integer or null | yes | output number; null = the whole run |
| `verdict` | one of `keep`, `maybe`, `reject`, `null` | yes |  |
| `checks` | object | no | checklist key -> pass \| fail \| na (na = cannot be seen in this image) |
| `checks.<key>` | one of `pass`, `fail`, `na` | no |  |
| `note` | string or null | no |  |
| `via` | one of `app`, `cli`, `chat`, `import` | no | how the verdict arrived |
| `legacy_id` | string or integer or null | no | records imported from another store keep their original id in legacy_id; null for records made here. It lets an imported record be traced back and is never shown in public text |

## run

one render run: <home>/runs/<run-id>/run.json, written at queue time and updated as the run moves; graph.json (the compiled API graph) and manifest.json sit beside it, outputs in outputs/NNN.png addressed (run, n). `easel runs import-legacy` writes one from a host run with legacy_id set.

- schema: `easel/run/1`
- file: [schemas/run.schema.json](../../schemas/run.schema.json)

| `legacy_id` | string or integer or null | no | records imported from another store keep their original id in legacy_id; null for records made here. It lets an imported record be traced back and is never shown in public text |
| `recipe` | string or null | no |  |
| `workflow` | string or null | no |  |
| `job` | string or null | no |  |

| `status` | one of `queued`, `running`, `ok`, `failed`, `oom`, `cancelled` | yes |  |
| `prompt_id` | string or null | no | ComfyUI's prompt id |
| `seed` | integer or null | no |  |
| `count` | integer | yes |  |
| `prompt` | string | yes |  |
| `negative` | string | no |  |
| `width` | integer or null | no |  |
| `height` | integer or null | no |  |
| `steps` | integer or null | no |  |
| `cfg` | number or null | no |  |
| `sampler` | string or null | no |  |
| `scheduler` | string or null | no |  |
| `denoise` | number or null | no |  |
| `started_at` | string or null | no |  |
| `finished_at` | string or null | no |  |
| `duration_s` | number or null | no |  |
| `gpu_peak_mb` | integer or null | no |  |
| `graph` | string | yes | a path relative to the root its record names: forward slashes, no drive, no leading slash, no `..` |

| `outputs[].n` | integer | yes |  |

| `outputs[].sha256` | string or null | yes |  |

| `outputs[].width` | integer or null | no |  |

| `outputs[].seed` | integer or null | no |  |
| `outputs[].metadata_stripped` | boolean | no |  |

| `legacy` | object | no | fields of an imported record that this format has no place for yet, kept verbatim by the import; tools ignore this block |

## usage-card

how to use one resource: values by source: Generated by `easel standards build`: one value per (field, source), so the author's advice, the references, your own experience and priors never overwrite each other. Precedence: manual > experience (n >= 3) > author > references > prior; `chosen` holds the winner per field. Manual values come from `standards set`.

- schema: `easel/usage-card/1`
- file: [schemas/usage-card.schema.json](../../schemas/usage-card.schema.json)
- example: [schemas/examples/usage-card.example.yaml](../../schemas/examples/usage-card.example.yaml)

| field | type | required | meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `schema` | `easel/usage-card/1` | yes | the format and its version; always the first key |
| `resource` | string | yes | a resource id: the first 16 hex digits of the file's sha256 |
| `generated_at` | string | yes | ISO 8601 time, for example 2030-01-01T00:00:00+00:00; easel always writes the T and the UTC offset. |
| `values` | array of object | yes |  |
| `values[].field` | string | yes | weight \| cfg \| steps \| sampler \| scheduler \| clip_skip \| width \| height \| prefix \| negative \| trigger \| hires_denoise |
| `values[].source` | one of `manual`, `experience`, `author`, `references`, `prior` | yes |  |
| `values[].value` | any | yes | a number, a string, or {min, max} |
| `values[].evidence` | string or null | no | the author's line, or for example 'n=12 references' |
| `values[].n` | integer or null | no |  |
| `values[].updated_at` | string or null | no |  |
| `chosen` | object | no |  |
| `chosen.<key>` | object | no |  |
| `chosen.<key>.value` | any | yes |  |
| `chosen.<key>.source` | one of `manual`, `experience`, `author`, `references`, `prior` | yes |  |
